paragraphs: Chapter 925
Episode 230. Invasion and Attack (6)

Despite repeated attempts to raise the energy of Gwangsimjang, the result was the same. For the first time since being recognized by the Myeongwang clan, Jin was experiencing the complete disappearance of his energy.
After a while, Gwangsimjang lost all its light and turned completely dark.
'Did my energy get blocked when Phaelito's sword, Bascara, grazed my cheek?'
Jin took a firm stance with a composed face, but he was actually at a loss for words.

He was shocked to realize that the energy he had always believed was 'completely his own power' was actually a privilege granted by the Myeongwang clan. Moreover, Phaelito blocked that power very easily.
His colleagues also noticed the problem with Jin.
Losing his energy meant that Jin could no longer use his most powerful sword. It meant the possibility of creating variables through Myeongwang's Realm Sword was completely blocked.
"……You intentionally blocked my energy now. After making me let my guard down."
"How does it feel to be a normal human being again?"
"Even if my energy is temporarily gone, it doesn't mean I've become a different person."
Phaelito smiled mockingly.
"Let's see if that's really the case."
Creak-!
Dante's strike grazed past Phaelito's nose. At the same time, Hedo's strength jabbed Phaelito's back, but he had already turned around and pushed Hedo away.
Murakan couldn't find time to deploy Dark Arrival.
Black chains and purple spears stretching out from the duplicated curtain, and the sword energy that Phaelito was shooting continuously, were keeping Murakan in check without a break.
'Damn it......! At this rate, I can't properly support the kid. That demon monster, if he's this brainwashed, what was he like before?'
From the outside, it seemed like four of them were pressing down on one, but the actual sensation the colleagues felt was the opposite. Phaelito was the one who kept pressing on them all along.
He had no blind spots.

The colleagues were realizing that Phaelito had no blind spots at all. Even when they happened to find a gap and aimed at it, none of their attacks ever succeeded, and Phaelito always fiercely charged into Jin's space.
Jin felt like he was fighting one-on-one. Every time he followed Phaelito's movements and changed his field of vision, he couldn't see his colleagues anywhere.
It was as if he was fighting someone in a dream.

His body was getting heavier and heavier. Every time he faced Phaelito's murderous intent, it felt as if dozens of snakes were wriggling inside his body. It felt like they could bite off his organs and pierce through his skin at any moment.
"Could it be that Vascara also has the ability to drain stamina? My breath is getting short too quickly...!"
Huu, huu! Every time he breathed, his throat roughened. It felt as if his throat was blocked and he couldn't breathe properly, and an unpleasant metallic taste scratched his nerves.

His strong body, which could fight for days after launching a special attack or secret technique, was getting tired quickly. It felt as if a disease he had never experienced in his life was tormenting him.
Phaelito's sword, which pricked his field of vision, was moving much faster than before. In reality, it wasn't that the sword was faster, but that Jin's reaction speed had slowed down.
"Cough!"
Hooddeok-!
Soon, Jin spat out a mouthful of blood and buckled.
Reflux.

There was an unstable surge within his body. Even for Jin, it was not easy to hide his startled expression. The body that had overcome its limits many times before was collapsing in such a short battle.
Soon, Jin was able to understand the reason.
'It's because of the Gwangshimjang...!'
Gwangshimjang is not just a repository of inner energy.
It was clearly an organ that constituted Jin's body. It was inevitable to have extreme stamina depletion as one of the two hearts that usually supported his body had completely lost its function.
It was fortunate that it ended only with stamina reduction. If Gwangshimjang was transplanted to be more involved in sustaining Jin's life, the fight would already be over.
"Do you still think that way? Even without Gwangshimjang, Jin Runcandel is Jin Runcandel. Feel it, that's your reality. When the overflowing power disappears, you're just a swordsman."
Cheoreong!
Jin was thrown far away by Phaelito's stab. Even before he hit the ground, magic sprouted like a spear from behind and from the ground.
The magic swept over Jin's clothes and skin. Although there were no deep wounds, blood spattered from his body and he had to be conscious of the bleeding due to his depleted stamina.
Adding to that, the sense of disruption from Hwangcheon's sword came again.
"A swordsman."
Jin spat out blood and switched his sword.
Bradamante, a sword mainly used when unfolding a spirit sword. However, like Sigmund, Bradamante could not hold the spirit.
The spirit just wrapped around the blade for a moment and then scattered into the air like a dried up paper.
'...... As expected, the spirit is also blocked.'

He was not as startled as he was with Gwangshimjang, as he had already expected it. Moreover, the spirit didn't directly involve Jin's body like the Gwangshimjang, so the problem of physical stamina did not increase.
However, the counterflow had already begun.
His comrades knew that Jin needed time to regain control over his counterflow. They couldn't let Phaelito continue to target Jin.
So, even if they had to risk injury, his comrades had to play a more dangerous game. However, Jin excluded Murakan from this plan.
"Murakan! Don't, if you're directly cut by Phaelito's sword, your spiritual energy will be restricted."
Unlike usual, Murakan immediately agreed with Jin's opinion.
Now was not the time to protest loudly and insist on his role as the guardian dragon. If he lost his spiritual energy, the battle would only get harder.
Besides, in the sky, not only the partially destroyed protective barrier of Ayula and the shattered duel circle of Talaris were visible.
Another rift.
Next to the rift from which Phaelito had emerged, a new rift was forming. A rift far larger than any other they had seen so far.
From that rift, demons would come out.
Demons that would tear the citizens of the Holy Kingdom apart, kill those trying to protect them, and steal what humanity was trying to protect from the earth were soon to pour out from the new rift.
- It's because of the Eye of Geoto, isn't it?

- Yes, Lord Quicantel. According to the information Bisebix provided, the current strongest person in the demon world is Phaelito, who is assumed to be Genesis, even though he is completely brainwashed... and following him are Ridolos and Bideluche. Geoto will certainly order them to find his eye.
The Alliance did not initially believe that Geoto would only send Phaelito to the Holy Kingdom. They expected the two demons, known to be given to Phaelito, and their troops to invade together.

Even in preparation for that time, Murakan's spiritual energy had to be preserved. Among the members of the Alliance, no one could more effectively block the indiscriminate mass murder by the enemies than Murakan.
"Darn it! Dante, Yukcheomi! I need your help!"
"Kaah!"
Dante pulled up his energy to the limit in an instant and fired ten Heavenly Piercing Strikes.

Nine of them were intercepted by magic and the duplicated spears of Ayula and were neutralized. A spear grazed Dante's side. Even as his own flesh fell off, Dante raised another wave of his Invisible Sword Wind to protect Jin.
The Invisible Sword Wind is something that not even Phaelito could read perfectly. The final Heavenly Piercing Strike, enveloped in the Invisible Sword Wind, finally pierced Phaelito's back.
"Hugh, huck……!"
Dante dodged another incoming spear while feeling dizzy and confirmed that the Heavenly Piercing Strike hit directly.
However, the Heavenly Piercing Strike did not pierce through Phaelito's back. Phaelito's stance was briefly disrupted, and blood splattered as his back exploded, but the wound was not deep.
Meanwhile, Hedo was charging at Phaelito. He covered Phaelito's front with his sword wave, which he had raised as big as a tsunami.

First, the sword wave swept Phaelito like a storm. Debris and blood from Phaelito's body mixed together, obscuring Ilsoon's vision, and Hedo took advantage of this moment of complete blindness to unleash a powerful strike.
The shock scattered the sword wave and the invisible sword wind, resonating with an ear-splitting explosion.
As soon as his vision cleared, Hedo found himself staring into the red eyes of Phaelito. Their powers, Basicala and Georyeok, crossed diagonally.
"You must have been proud of your strength."
"Grrr!"
"Luckily, you were born with the power of the Sun God. Today, I'll kill you and erase one of the chaos left by the order of the old age."
The power of the Sun God's fragment was certainly a privilege, but it could not be limited by Basicala's power. Just as light cannot erase light.

Phaelito frowned, seemingly displeased. Not because he couldn't decrease Hedo's Georyeok with Basicala, but because he was annoyed at Hedo daring to confront him directly with the power of the Sun God, which he got for nothing.
Grrrr...!
The primal struggle of power continued. And it didn't take long for the result to emerge.
Hedo started to step back.
The giant, who had never been pushed back in a power confrontation, gritted his teeth, shivering, and sweating profusely from his entire body. All his joints were trembling.
"Aghhhh...!"
"Let's destroy such a thing as the power of the Sun God who hasn't even awakened."
If Hedo had held on any longer, both of his arms would have collapsed.
However, Hedo quickly took a defensive posture as soon as he confirmed the gap. Naturally, as soon as Hedo lost his center, Phaelito thrust his sword towards Hedo's neck.
Dante was already moving to help Hedo, but Phaelito was faster. Hedo, in an unstable posture, dropped his Georyeok trying to fend off Basicala.
Next, when Phaelito was about to pierce Hedo's heart by throwing his fallen Georyeok far away...
Beeeeep...!
Phaelito withdrew his sword, suddenly feeling a ringing in his head.
The pain of burning eyes as if he was looking directly at the sun was also there. Of course, such pain could not make Phaelito flinch.
What now blocked Phaelito was the legacy left by a magician who shook the world long ago to Jin.
It was Chenmi's flash bomb. At some point, Jin, who had silenced the reflux, set off a flash bomb in front of Phaelito.
Phaelito, with an absurd expression, raised his magic to confirm Jin's position. Jin was standing in front of Hedo, who was also exposed by the flash bomb.
"Is it teeth or gums, Jin Runcandel."
Jin steeled himself, his eyes wide open. The determination to face the sword devil without soul energy, without brain energy.
"Phaelito. I am not a swordsman, but a magic swordsman of Runcandel. So, as you said, this could be my real teeth, not my gums."
